notes: Evaluation queries for the Reuters-21578 ModApte test split. Every query is written for one TOPICS category; a document is relevant when it carries that topic (grade 2 when the topic is its only topic, grade 1 otherwise). The 'kind' field groups the queries by how far their wording is from the vocabulary of the relevant stories: topic word / Reuters vocabulary / synonym or paraphrase / semantic description. Topics were assigned by Reuters and Carnegie Group indexers in 1987, independently of any retrieval method.
